commit.message: kb: copy specialist profiles into corpus docs

kb: make coverage additive and unjam the intake handoff

Coverage stops being an admission gate. A candidate enters with whatever it
can evidence and later passes add to it; a game absent from the corpus teaches
nothing. Rules coverage stays the working aim, components may land low-to-mid,
and no percentage withholds a packet.

What replaces it is the honesty of the ledger. intake-lib keeps the arithmetic
checks that stop a ledger flattering itself - a count may not exceed its
denominator, a percentage must be the computed result, an unretrieved
denominator stays null - and drops the 100% bounded-inventory requirement.
Admission now rests entirely on claim-level Source/Evidence/Confidence support.

Open followups may enter a promotable packet. Forbidding them only pressured a
worker to leave a known gap unrecorded, which is the opposite of the intent.

Completion becomes a merge-time law rather than an open-PR law. The PR view
demanded a promoted head at exactly the moment the auditor is meant to read a
ready_for_audit packet, and only the auditor can author the approval that
promotion requires - so no scout action could clear it and PR #38 deadlocked
twice on it. The push-to-main path still refuses any unpromoted intake.

The pipeline is documented as unattended throughout: every followup and gap
lead must name a document a later scheduled run can fetch, because nothing
waits on a person. Provenance records keep their dated instructions under a
neutral operator label rather than being erased.

Also defines "private" in the visual contract as this repository and its
private sync targets, so two audits of one packet cannot reach opposite
conclusions on an undefined word.
